## Summary

Independent human evaluation of entity resolution now has a prepared, honest
channel that cannot be confused with operational review or silently certified.

- **Preregistration (`resolution/src/resolution/human_eval.py`, ~800 LOC).**
  `CampaignDesign`/`preregister_campaign` digests an immutable design record —
  `protocol_digest`, `frame_snapshot`, `ruleset_digest`, `seed`, target population,
  grouping + sampling specs, `rubric_version`. A changed rubric/ruleset/frame is a
  **new** campaign; the design has no mutable fields.
- **Dependency-disjoint splits.** Pairs are union-found into dependency groups by
  shared subject entity, shared candidate component and duplicated upstream-record
  (republisher/mirror) lineage; partitions (`training`/`development`/`sealed_final`)
  are assigned **per group** per stratum with seeded SHA-256 ordering and
  stratum-homogenization — no entity/component/lineage crosses the sealed boundary;
  designated holdout families are forced `sealed_final`.
- **Seeded sample with explicit probabilities.** `draw_eval_sample` draws
  deterministically per stratum and records per-row `selection_probability`,
  `weight`, stratum size, dependency-group counts, `draw_order`, `estimand`,
  `reference_basis`. Sample ids are opaque `hev-<digest>` handles.
- **Tamper-evident manifest.** `write_manifest`/`verify_manifest` recompute the
  manifest digest over live rows — any edited membership/probability/partition is
  detected on `eval verify`.
- **Blinded packets.** `build_blinded_packet` emits raw+normalized observations,
  authorized source names/ids, capture dates with uncertainty, excerpts/locators,
  lineage facts and neutral geometry — deterministic left/right randomization and
  item order; `assert_blinded` hard-fails on model tier/score, predicted
  disposition, cluster membership, model/agent labels or rationale, other
  reviewers' labels and generated merge conclusions. Every label pins the
  `packet_digest` it was issued against.
- **Additive schema (`human_eval_campaign` sqitch change).** Nine append-only
  tables — campaign/manifest/sample/packet/assignment/attestation/label/
  adjudication/release — all immutability-triggered, no UPDATE/DELETE grants;
  supersession is a new row. `label ∈ same|different|insufficient_evidence`,
  `attestation_id` FK (a label cannot exist without its reviewer's human
  attestation), chained `label_digest` watermark.
- **Least-privilege roles.** `sig_eval_admin` (prepare/read-released),
  `sig_eval_reviewer` (RLS `sig.eval_reviewer` — own assignments/packets/labels
  only), `sig_eval_custodian` (read-all + adjudication + release, **no** label
  grant — proven by test). `sig_materialize`, `sig_read_*`, `sig_export`,
  `sig_ingest` hold **zero** eval grants; released views stay empty until a
  custodian-recorded `human_eval_release`, so sealed labels are unreachable from
  clustering/model-development views by construction.
- **CLI.** `sig-resolution eval {frame, prepare, packets, assign, status, export,
  attest, import-labels, adjudicate, unseal, verify, watermark}` — every command
  `SET ROLE`s appropriately; labels enter only through `import-labels` under
  `sig_eval_reviewer` + `sig.eval_reviewer`.
- **Packets.** `docs/evaluation/` — `rubric.md` (`eval-rubric/1`, the same-device
  question and the three labels), `training-pilot-packet.md` (40-item pilot,
  freeze checklist, rules-author firewall), `reviewer-provisioning.md`
  (pseudonymous accounts, `sig.eval_reviewer` token, attestations,
  deprovisioning), `measured-time-worksheet.md`, `human-campaign-marker-packet.md`
  (states; current marker **`tooling_ready`**, 0 labels/attestations).
- **Consensus + adjudication.** Two equal `same`/`different` first-pass votes
  yield the reference label; **any** disagreement or `insufficient_evidence`
  routes to adjudication whose `unresolved` outcome is permanent — abstentions
  stay in denominators and can never auto-accept a pair.
- **Operational review untouched.** `review_decision` keeps its `accept`/`reject`
  contract; nothing in `human_eval_*` feeds clustering — P31.10/P31.11 compat
  proven by a dedicated PG test.
- **ADR-128** + Appendix F row + regenerated spec + ADR index + BL-058 sources;
  `COVERAGE_MATRIX` SIG-EVAL-001/002 → `covered+tested / PARTIAL` (human
  participation deferred); DEFERRALS annotated.
